1.t: By the [winds] sent forth in swift succession,

6.t: as a proof or a warning:

7.t: what you are promised will come to pass.

9.t: and the sky is torn apart,

10.t: when the mountains are turned to dust

11.t: and the messengers given their appointed time––

12.t: for what Day has all this been set?

14.t: What will explain to you what the Day of Decision is?

15.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

16.t: Did We not destroy the first [of them]?

17.t: We shall make the last follow them:

18.t: this is how We deal with the guilty.

19.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

20.t: Did We not make you from an underrated fluid

21.t: which We housed in a safe lodging

23.t: We determine [it]: how excellently We determine!

24.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

25.t: Did We not make the earth a home

26.t: for the living and the dead?

27.t: Did We not place firm, lofty mountains on it and provide you with sweet water?

28.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

29.t: They will be told, ‘Go to that which you used to deny!

30.t: Go to a shadow of smoke!’ It rises in three columns;

31.t: no shade does it give, nor relief from the flame;

32.t: it shoots out sparks as large as treetrunks

34.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

35.t: On that Day they will be speechless,

36.t: and they will be given no chance to offer any excuses.

37.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

38.t: [They will be told], ‘This is the Day of Decision: We have gathered you and earlier generations.

39.t: If you have any plots against Me, try them now.’

40.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

41.t: But those who took heed of God will enjoy cool shade, springs,

43.t: [they will be told], ‘Eat and drink to your hearts’ content as a reward for your deeds:

44.t: this is how We reward those who do good.’

45.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

46.t: [You may] eat and enjoy yourselves for a short while, evildoers that you are.

47.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

48.t: When they are told, ‘Bow down in prayer,’ they do not do so.

49.t: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

50.t: In what revelation, after this, will they believe?
